episodes.title: Chapter 1: Sleep of the Just
episodes.summary: While searching for an escaped nightmare in the waking world, Morpheus falls prey to Roderick Burgess, an occultist looking to summon and imprisoned Death.

episodes.title: Chapter 2: Imperfect Hosts
episodes.summary: Morpheus begins his quest to find his tools of power - his sand, ruby and helm - by paying a visit to a pair of notoriously dysfunctional brothers.

episodes.title: Chapter 3: Dream a Little Dream of Me
episodes.summary: Morpheus tracks down the last-known person in possession of his sand - and receives an unexpected lesson on humanity. Ethel pays a visit to her son.

episodes.title: Chapter 4: A Hope in Hell
episodes.summary: A lead on the whereabouts of his helm compels Morpheus to seek an audience with Lucifer. A confused John receives a helping hand from a good Samaritan.

episodes.title: Chapter 5: 24/7
episodes.summary: With Morpheus caught off guard, John settles in at a diner to watch the people around him - and put his theory about truth and lies to a terrifying test.

episodes.title: Chapter 6: The Sound of Her Wings
episodes.summary: Feeling a bit rudderless, Morpheus shadows his hard-working big sister, who offers him advice and encourages him to reconnect with an old acquaintance.

episodes.title: Chapter 7: The Doll's House
episodes.summary: Lucienne comes to Morpheus with disturbing news. Rose Walker goes in search of family. Admirers of the Corinthian's work scheme to get his attention.

episodes.title: Chapter 8: Playing House
episodes.summary: As Morpheus closes in on one of this missing creations, Rose ramps up efforts to locate her brother - and unwittingly makes a friend's dream come true.

episodes.title: Chapter 9: Collectors
episodes.summary: Odd disturbances shake up The Dreaming, Rose sets out on a road trip with a new friend, and The Corinthian arrives with a guest at a creepy convention.

episodes.title: Chapter 10: Lost Hearts
episodes.summary: As the Dream vortex grows more powerful and the walls betwen the realms weaken, Rose must make a difficult choice. Morpheus contronts The Corinthian.

episodes.title: Chapter 11: Season of Mists
episodes.summary: When a gathering of the Endless exposes deep-seated grievances, Morpheus embarks on a mission to Hell to free the soul of a condemned mortal.

episodes.title: Chapter 12: The Ruler of Hell
episodes.summary: Bequeathed the key to Hell, Morpheus throws a lavish banquet to determine which god, demon or faerie can be entrusted with its dark power.

episodes.title: Chapter 13: More Devils Than Vast Hell Can Hold
episodes.summary: All the world's a stage as Morpheus summons history's greatest dramatist to perform an enchanting play for a supernatural audience.

episodes.title: Chapter 14: Brief Lives
episodes.summary: Morpheus grudgingly helps Delirium search for their vanished sibling in the waking world — where a deadly force lurks in the shadows.

episodes.title: Chapter 15: The Song of Orpheus
episodes.summary: To honor a promise to one sibling, Morpheus must shatter a vow to another. In ancient Greece, a wedding-night tragedy turns a son against his father.

episodes.title: Chapter 16: Family Blood
episodes.summary: Morpheus enlists an expert in the occult to smuggle a deeply personal relic out of Paris — and help him and Delirium find the answers they seek.

episodes.title: Chapter 17: Time and Night
episodes.summary: With the future of his realm at stake, Morpheus must appeal for help to an authority even greater than the Endless.

episodes.title: Chapter 18: Fuel for the Fire
episodes.summary: Morpheus recruits a mortal agent for a dangerous mission in the waking world. A change of heart puts a pair of tricksters on a collision course.

episodes.title: Chapter 19: The Kindly Ones
episodes.summary: Confined to his realm, Morpheus conjures up a new nightmare to do his bidding. The God of Deception deals roughly with an intrusive thorn in his side.

episodes.title: Chapter 20: Long Live the King
episodes.summary: Fueled by rage, a grieving mother unleashes her wrath upon the Dreaming, as Morpheus confronts the Kindly Ones at the furthest reaches of his kingdom.

episodes.title: Chapter 21: A Tale of Graceful Ends
episodes.summary: As deities, dreamers and demons unite to mark a momentous occasion, the Endless assemble for a family reunion unlike any other.
